x: Alf Harley's enthusiasm has been with us ever since. The first photograph appeared in the edition for Sept/Oct. 1929 and was of the new President, E.

E.Gordon proposed that F.G.Thomson should be President for the ensuing year. He said that Mr.Thomson had joined the Club in 1889 - two years after formation - and had been honoured with Life Membership as far back as 1897.
It is with sorrow that we have to advise the death of Ted Gordon, in his 89th year; a Past President and Trustee of the Club and a vital personality in the growth of the Belgrave Harriers.
The photograph shown opposite has stired his memories still further and he tells of the recollections this picture brings. 1.J.SAWYER 2.E.GORDON. 3.T.EATON. 4.D.McLEAN. 5.W.SAVAGE. 6.

The photograph reproduced here is one of our few pre-World War I groups and features; R.W. Ricketts, E.
Great-grandfather was Edwin Gordon, Past President and one time Mayor of New Malden; his Great Aunt was Elsie, who is remembered in the name of one of our trophies - the Elsie Cup.
